title: Across the Loss Landscape with Progressive Growth
abstract: arXiv:2608.24568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks generalize well despite their highly nonconvex, overparameterized loss landscapes, a phenomenon often associated with the geometry of the minima found by stochastic optimization. We study how incremental grow-and-optimize strategies bias training toward flatter regions by viewing growth as progressive constraint relaxation. Starting from a low-dimensional submodel, we iteratively expand the trainable parameters by unlocking nested random subspaces while freezing the orthogonal complement at the network initialization, re-optimizing after each expansion until the full architecture is reached. Under standard local regularity conditions around non-degenerate minima, we prove that local sublevel sets are well approximated by ellipsoids and that basin accessibility under frozen constraints can be characterized by an explicit effective curvature in the frozen directions. This leads to an explanation of the bias: progress

translated_title: 跨越损失景观的渐进式增长
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24568v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：深度神经网络尽管具有高度非凸、过参数化的损失景观，但其泛化性能良好，这一现象通常与随机优化所找到的最小值的几何特性相关。我们通过将增长视为渐进约束松弛，研究了增量式“增长与优化”策略如何将训练偏向于更平坦的区域。从低维子模型开始，我们通过解锁嵌套的随机子空间来迭代扩展可训练参数，同时在网络初始化时冻结正交补空间，每次扩展后重新优化，直到达到完整架构。在非退化最小值附近的标准局部正则条件下，我们证明了局部子水平集可由椭球体良好近似，且在冻结约束下的盆地可达性可通过冻结方向上的显式有效曲率来表征。这引出了对偏置的解释：进展
tldr: 本文提出通过渐进约束松弛的增量增长策略，证明其将训练偏向更平坦最小值区域，并给出盆地可达性的有效曲率解释。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes incremental growth via progressive constraint relaxation, proving it biases training toward flatter minima regions with an effective curvature explanation for basin accessibility.
